sponsored.t: Permits the commissioner of health to designate local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records
sponsored.sum: Permits the commissioner of health to designate local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records relating to a death.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 43 Chapter 662 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7411, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the county law, in relation to permitting the commissioner of health to designate local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records" APPROVED This bill would allow the Commissioner of Health to designate a local health official as the Commissioner's designee for the purpose of requesting copies of reports and records related to a death. I support the goal of this legislation, which is to assist local health officials in the fulfillment of their mission to reduce preventa- ble injury and death by providing them with records necessary to better monitor illnesses, injuries, and deaths in their jurisdictions. However, the bill does not fully address this issue, as it provides local health officials with only indirect access to such records. I have…

sponsored.t: Relates to removing residency requirements for Franklin county assistant district attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for persons holding the office of assistant district attorney for the county of Franklin; provides that a person holding such office may reside in Franklin county or an adjoining county within the state.

sponsored.t: Raises the Clinton county hotel or motel tax from three percent to five percent
sponsored.sum: Raises the Clinton county hotel or motel tax from three percent to five percent.

sponsored.t: Establishes a water and waste water treatment system capital fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a water and waste water treatment system capital fund for municipalities.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the North Country Craft Beer Trail
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the North Country Craft Beer Trail.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating an exemption to the snowmobile registration requirements by creating a seasonal trail pass pilot program for Canadian citizens
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating an exemption to the snowmobile registration requirements by creating a seasonal trail pass pilot program for Canadian citizens where registered Canadian snowmobilers will pay applicable fees but no additional registration materials are utilized.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sentencing requirements for the offenses of hindering prosecution and conspiracy
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sentencing requirements for the offenses of hindering prosecution and conspiracy.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing disclosures in furtherance of the enforcement of state law
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing disclosures in furtherance of the enforcement of state law.

sponsored.t: Relates to custody and visitation rights of certain sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Relates to custody and visitation rights of certain sex offenders.

sponsored.t: Limits the number of consecutive hours worked by certain employees of N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of consecutive hours worked by certain employees of cities of one million or more; provides that employees of cities of one million or more who are subject to a collective bargaining agreement shall not work more than 17 consecutive hours in a work day.

sponsored.t: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans; provides that such tax credit is worth $3,000 per veteran hired or $4,000 for every disabled veteran hired and the total benefit shall not exceed $15,000 annually.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state to convey certain forest preserve land
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state to convey certain forest preserve land; provides such sale shall be subject to legislative approval and the proceeds of such conveyance shall be used for acquisitions to the forest preserve.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Samuel Trombley
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Ellenburg, county of Clinton to Samuel Trombley.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to cover costs for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome rehabilitation treatment.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance and Medicaid coverage for inpatient and outpatient substance abuse treatment for a period of not less than forty-five days.

sponsored.t: Authorizes real property taxing jurisdictions to grant a partial tax exemption for property purchased by a clinician in a clinician shortage area
sponsored.sum: Authorizes real property taxing jurisdictions to grant a partial tax exemption for property purchased by a clinician in a clinician shortage area, as determined by the commissioner of health, which will be such clinician's primary residence and they will practice in such shortage area; provides state aid to taxing jurisdictions which grant the exemption to the extent of the tax savings provided to clinicians.

sponsored.t: Grants a waiver to Adirondack Helping Hands for the 2016--2017 school year
sponsored.sum: Grants a waiver in the amount of $52,000 to Adirondack Helping Hands for services rendered during the 2016--2017 school year; provides such waiver shall be allocated to costs associated with special class in an integrated setting spending for the 2016--2017 school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to special districts for ambulance services and to volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services; requires a report on issues of volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of an ATV recreation fund and the use of ATVs
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of an ATV recreation fund and the use of ATVs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the exemption from inspection for certain meat products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the exemption from inspection for certain meat products.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain acquisition of interests or rights in real property for the preservation of open spaces and areas
sponsored.sum: Provides that the acquisition of interests or rights in real property for the preservation of open spaces and areas shall constitute a public purpose for which public funds may be expended or advanced.

sponsored.t: Relates to the delivery of the good faith deposit following award of the bonds to the successful bidder
sponsored.sum: Relates to the delivery of the good faith deposit following award of the bonds to the successful bidder; provides that a municipality, school district or district corporation may require that such deposit be made as a condition precedent to the consideration of a bid for the bonds.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include purpose-bred animals raised for research, service animals, working dogs or any working animals in service on a farm.

sponsored.t: Establishes state procurement goals for New York state products throughout state agencies and private entities performing state contracts
sponsored.sum: Establishes state procurement goals for New York state products throughout state agencies and private entities performing state contracts; provides that every year after enactment, a certain percentage of products purchased by state agencies will be New York state products, with such percentage threshold increasing each year up until five years.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspend taxes on home heating fuels; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop, implement, administer and operate a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspends certain taxes on home heating fuels; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Creates a volunteer firefighter training fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates a volunteer firefighter training fund; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to testimonies in parole hearings
sponsored.sum: Requires that all comments and testimony made by a third party either in support or opposition in a parole hearing shall be considered when coming to a decision; adds provisions relating to confidentiality of victim statements.

sponsored.t: Relates to state aid for emergency medical services
sponsored.sum: Classifies emergency medical services as essential services for the purposes of state aid.

sponsored.t: Relates to the business income rate and expanding the small business subtraction modification
sponsored.sum: Relates to the business income rate and expanding the small business subtraction modification.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Adirondack park affordable housing task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Adirondack park affordable housing task force; requires such task force to conduct a comprehensive review of affordable housing issues within the Adirondack park and to make recommendations for addressing such issues.

sponsored.t: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home in rural areas
sponsored.sum: Authorizes one or more demonstration projects that permit a managed long-term care plan to enroll persons that are permanently placed in a nursing home and to manage the nursing home benefit in one or more rural areas.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval for the closure of correctional facilities and institutions
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative approval for the closure of correctional facilities and institutions.

sponsored.t: Creates a volunteer firefighter scholarship program and a volunteer firefighter scholarship fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates a volunteer firefighter scholarship program and a volunteer firefighter scholarship fund; rewards volunteer firefighters who respond to twenty-five percent of emergency calls for eight years with a student loan award equal to four times the SUNY tuition rate; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes the volunteer fire departments capital fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the volunteer fire departments capital fund under the office of fire prevention and control; appropriates funds for such capital fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes a procedure for the creation of new counties
sponsored.sum: Establishes a procedure for the creation of new counties; outlines population and area requirements; requires a feasibility study, petition and referendum; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the forest ranger force to establish a training program for volunteer search and rescue personnel to assist the forest rangers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the forest ranger force to establish a training program for volunteer search and rescue personnel to assist the forest rangers in wild, remote and forested areas of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid reimbursement rates for rural home health care providers
sponsored.sum: Increases Medicaid reimbursement rates for rural home health care providers to cover actual costs of delivery.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Adds falsely reporting the use of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument as part of the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Relates to including a representative of the drug or medical device manufacturer industry on the state board of pharmacy
sponsored.sum: Provides that there shall be a representative of the drug or medical device manufacturer industry on the state board of pharmacy.

sponsored.t: Grants an exemption for the purchase of certain tangible personal property and services used in the operation of recreational skiing facilities from state sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Grants an exemption for the purchase of energy efficient snow making equipment, ski lift equipment, snow grooming equipment, and the production of snow by a recreational ski facility from state sales and compensating use tax.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"; requires health care facilities have policies for suspected victims of domestic abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to supporting depositions that are served at the time of issuance of a simplified information
sponsored.sum: Relates to supporting depositions that are served at the time of issuance of a simplified information.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the villages of Malone, Saranac Lake and Tupper Lake, in the county of Franklin, to employ retired former members of the division of state police as part-time village police officers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the villages of Malone, Saranac Lake and Tupper Lake, in the county of Franklin, to employ retired former members of the division of state police as part-time village police officers.

sponsored.t: Permits schools to allow fire departments to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
sponsored.sum: Permits the principal of any high school to allow any local fire department, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of fire department junior recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

sponsored.t: Allows the granting of academic credit at city or state operated institutions to veterans
sponsored.sum: Allows the granting of academic credit at state or city operated institutions to veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to special districts for ambulance services and to volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services in any county, city, town or village located within the Adirondack park; requires a report on issues of volunteer firefighter and ambulance services staffing.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to review cellular service within the state
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "cellular mapping act"; requires the public service commission to review cellular services within the state; requires the expansion of cellular services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Clinton, to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Clinton to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers.

sponsored.t: Repeals a provision of the civil service law relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs to provide such deputy sheriffs with the same interest arbitration scope as municipal police officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to bioheating fuel requirements
sponsored.sum: Relates to bioheating fuel requirements; allows B100 or B99 biofuel and R100 or R99 renewable fuel to be used to blend with or replace fossil heating oil in order to create bioheating fuel.

sponsored.t: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs; directs the municipal police training council to promulgate rules and regulations relating to qualification for municipal police forces for persons who were previously sworn members of the state police and to provide certificates to such persons who meet such qualifications.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state disaster emergency grant and loan program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state disaster emergency grant and loan program administered by industrial development agencies for certain small businesses.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures and other matters related to the receipt or discontinuation of certain benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires that all procedures and other matters related to the receipt or discontinuation of benefits available under section two hundred seven-c of the general municipal law shall be subject, upon request of the affected employee, to a de novo evidentiary hearing.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Plattsburgh
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Plattsburgh, not to exceed five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Makes certain fees and charges related to emergency medical services permanent
sponsored.sum: Makes certain fees and charges related to emergency medical services permanent.

sponsored.t: Establishes the USDA construction tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the USDA construction tax credit for a percentage of the profit on any newly constructed home that is sold to someone qualifying with a USDA mortgage.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "broadband deployment assistance act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "broadband deployment assistance act"; requires that substantially similar permits for broadband deployment be processed together at the same time and on an expedited basis; defines terms; authorizes municipalities to simultaneously process certain broadband permit applications that are substantially similar.

sponsored.t: Requires health benefits for state and retired state employees have the option to only cover the employee or retiree and their spouse or domestic partner
sponsored.sum: Requires health benefits for state and retired state employees have the option to only cover the employee or retiree and their spouse or domestic partner.

sponsored.t: Establishes law enforcement officer grant funds and firefighter grant funds
sponsored.sum: Establishes law enforcement officer grant funds and firefighter grant funds to cover expenses related to hiring law enforcement officers and firefighters and equipment and resources for such officers and firefighters.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee to provide a mechanism for interagency cooperation and coordination to implement the recommendations of the report of the Adirondack road salt reduction task force.

sponsored.t: Designates officers and members of a fire investigation unit as peace officers in Franklin county
sponsored.sum: Designates officers and members of a fire investigation unit as peace officers in Franklin county.

sponsored.t: Relates to installments of bonds; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permanently requires that the first installment of serial bonds mature not later than two years after the date of such bonds; provides that principal installments remaining unpaid on bonds may be called for redemption prior to their date of maturity in such amounts, at such times in such manner and pursuant to such terms as may be determined by the finance board of a municipality, school district or corporation at the time of the issuance thereof; repeals provisions that permanently eliminate the requirement that municipalities provide from current funds an amount equal to at least 5% of the estimated cost of each capital improvement (excluding from such cost state or federal grant funding…

sponsored.t: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries
sponsored.sum: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries.

sponsored.t: Requires uniform criteria for evaluation and selection of grants and loans by the New York state industrial development agency
sponsored.sum: Relates to loans and grants by industrial development agencies; requires uniform criteria for evaluation and selection of an eligible entity for a loan; defines terms; outlines such criteria.

sponsored.t: Relates to a presumption for Parkinson's disease
sponsored.sum: Provides that where any condition of impairment of health caused by Parkinson's disease, resulting in total or partial disability or death to a volunteer firefighter, where such volunteer firefighter successfully passed a physical examination on entry into such service or subsequent thereto, which examination failed to reveal any evidence of such condition, shall be presumptive evidence that such disability or death was caused by the natural and proximate result of an accident, not caused by such firefighter's own negligence; and was incurred in the performance and discharge of duty, unless the contrary be proven by competent evidence.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers of the New York state industrial development agency
sponsored.sum: Relates to the powers of the New York state industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to abolishing the office of coroner
sponsored.sum: Abolishes the office of coroner.

sponsored.t: Relates to referrals of certain annexation petitions
sponsored.sum: Requires county planning departments to review specific annexation petitions.

sponsored.t: Relates to making housing a policy in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that a policy of this state should be to increase housing options and opportunities, including but not limited to affordable, and workforce and senior housing.

sponsored.t: Grants Ethan Czyzewski tier II status in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Grants Ethan Czyzewski tier II status in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the public safety surcharge
sponsored.sum: Removes language requiring the state from moving public safety surcharge funds into the state general fund; increases from seventy-five million dollars to one million dollars available for grants or reimbursements to counties for the development, consolidation, or operation of public safety communications systems or networks designed to support statewide interoperable communications for first responders.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a distinctive plate for combat veterans having served in the navy, marine corps, air force or coast guard
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a distinctive plate for combat veterans having served in the navy, marine corps, air force or coast guard.

sponsored.t: Grants members or officers of the state police credit for service as a deputy sheriff, county corrections officer, or state corrections officer
sponsored.sum: Grants certain members or officers of the state police credit for service as a deputy sheriff, county corrections officer, or state corrections officer; two years credit; provides cost shall be borne by member.

sponsored.t: Allows beneficiaries of certain deceased members to elect to receive death benefits in a lump sum
sponsored.sum: Allows a beneficiary of a member whose death occurs on or after July 1, 2025 and who would have been entitled to a service credit at the time of such member's death to elect to receive a lump sum payment equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a distinctive "North Country Honor Flight" license plate; establishes the North Country Honor Flight fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a distinctive "North Country Honor Flight" license plate; establishes the North Country Honor Flight fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of Native American affairs
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of Native American affairs to act as a centralized office for Native American nations to access information on state programs that are provided to Native Americans.

sponsored.t: Limits the number of hours certain public employees can work
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of hours certain public employees can work.

sponsored.t: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans
sponsored.sum: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans.

sponsored.t: Waives certain licensure fees for seniors
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensure fees for seniors.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "pretrial risk overview for threat evaluation, custody, and treatment (PROTECT) act"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "pretrial risk overview for threat evaluation, custody, and treatment (PROTECT) Act" to evaluate certain defendants; establishes a risk assessment instrument to aid judges in determining whether to release or detain a principal, where and when a release is appropriate and necessary conditions that should be imposed as part of such release; repeals provisions of law relating to qualifying offenses and allows a court to set bail or remand a principal where based on the risk assessment instrument, where the principal poses a safety risk or risk of flight; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Creates a wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel
sponsored.sum: Creates a $1,500 wage tax credit for employers who employ New York national guard members, reservists, volunteer firefighters and EMS personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to volunteer members of village fire companies.

sponsored.t: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Extends tuition free course benefits to volunteer firefighters or voluntary ambulance workers; authorizes the board of trustees of the state university to regulate the conferral of such benefits.

sponsored.t: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain employees of the New York Power Authority
sponsored.sum: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for employees of the New York Power Authority who are a member of the public employee organization certified or recognized to represent employees of such authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of state, county and municipal 911 operators and dispatchers
sponsored.sum: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain public safety dispatchers, public safety telecommunicators, 911 operators, communications officers, police communication technicians, emergency services operators and emergency services dispatchers employed by the state, or a county or municipal emergency services department.

sponsored.t: Provides that only products containing milk may use the term "milk product" on labels and advertisements
sponsored.sum: Provides that only products containing milk may use the term "milk product" on labels and advertisements; defines "milk product".

sponsored.t: Regulates the use of cooperative purchasing agreements for public works projects by political subdivisions of the state
sponsored.sum: Regulates the use of cooperative purchasing agreements for public works projects by political subdivisions of the state by implementing certain advertisement requirements.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Franklin to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Clinton to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the open auction bond sale pilot program
sponsored.sum: Extends the open auction bond sale pilot program.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid
sponsored.sum: Allows out of state health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid 2025.

sponsored.t: Enacts the private activity bond allocation act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Enacts the private activity bond allocation act to establish an alternative formula for making volume ceiling allocations.

sponsored.t: Amends chapter 668 of the laws of 1977, amending the volunteer firefighters' benefit law relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries, in relation to the effectiveness
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries.

sponsored.t: Requires events held by the state or on state property which include alcohol to include alcohol produced within the state
sponsored.sum: Requires events held by the state or on state property which include alcohol to include alcohol produced within the state.

sponsored.t: Permits sales during the Adirondack Family Book Festival at the John Brown Farm State Historic Site in North Elba, Essex County
sponsored.sum: Permits sales during the Adirondack Family Book Festival at the John Brown Farm State Historic Site in North Elba, Essex County.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County.

sponsored.t: Relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York land-home property act"; relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property.

sponsored.t: Relates to vintage snowmobile registrations
sponsored.sum: Relates to vintage snowmobile registrations for snowmobiles manufactured more than thirty years prior.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Mount Van Hoevenberg Olympic Sports Complex in Essex County.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with the Milan Cortina Winter Olympic Games sliding sports competitions
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with the Milan Cortina Winter Olympic Games sliding sports competitions, Lake Placid 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to municipal cybersecurity incidents or ransomware attacks
sponsored.sum: Requires all municipal corporations to report cybersecurity incidents and demands of ransom payments to the division of homeland security and emergency services; defines terms; requires cybersecurity incident reviews; requires cybersecurity awareness training, cybersecurity protection and data protection standards for state maintained information systems.
